text:
maya: heads-up — preflight SLO check for the eu-west deploy window, I see a short p95 spike on embeds around 12:08 UTC. not huge but worth watching.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by @olivia — version v3.2.1, canary -> 10% traffic, change-window eu-west 12:00-13:00 UTC :rocket:
olivia: i can confirm — p95 jumped ~90ms -> ~420ms for ~5m, grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/embeds?panelId=7&orgId=1
sam: fwiw traces sampling for embeds is 1% so it's noisy. might be a couple noisy requests amplifying the p95. can we relax alerting briefly?
liam-oncall: also seeing small uptick in 502s on /v1/embeds, counts under 100/min atm. not yet sustained.
maya: i'd rather avoid a rollback unless 5xx% sustained >0.5% for 10m. propose we: 1) bump p95 alert threshold by +15s for the window, 2) increase aggregation to 5m, 3) tighten 502 sampling query. thoughts? :thinking:
olivia: agree. prefer quick noise-mitigation first. @sre-bot can you apply a temporary alert tweak?
sre-bot: ack — applying temporary alert changes for channel "embeds": set p95 threshold += 15000ms until 13:30 UTC; set evaluation window -> 5m; add debounce 3x. Logging sample unchanged.
deploy-bot: canary rollout progressed 10% -> 30% per autoscaler, no errors flagged by rollout checks.
sam: adding a quick logs query for 502 root cause, please run if you have access: ```
# kql
service:embeds status:502 | group_by reason | count() | sort desc
```
liam-oncall: plan: if 5xx rate >0.5% for 10m OR 502 spikes >200/min for 5m -> rollback. use `/deploy rollback v3.2.1` if triggered.
olivia: noted. i'll keep manual watch and pause traffic if we see the thresholds. holding on rollback for now. thanks. :+1:
maya: leaving this thread open during the window — ping here with any infra logs or pager hits. i'll post a short summary after the window.
__note: This document is a single Slack thread string; messages are chronological and prefixed with sender names.
